name: Fused bias + GELU
description: Compute out = gelu(x + bias) with exact (erf) GELU; bias is broadcast over rows. Compute in float32; inputs/output float16.
signature: run(x: Tensor[M, N], bias: Tensor[N]) -> Tensor[M, N]
provenance: Original KernelRL task (written from scratch). Task category inspired by KernelBench level 2 (github.com/ScalingIntelligence/KernelBench, MIT license); no KernelBench code copied.
